title: Rapid decline
text: I was a very pleased & happy subscriber for a few years. Then a new editor took over & things went down hill rapidly. The neon pink plastic (ugly, in my opinion, as well as totally environmentally irresponsible) storage bag went from something attractive & ecologically sound to an inferior, poor quality (my 1st month it came with split seams), too-small-to-hold-all-the-products one. Products decreased in size & especially quality. If I wanted beauty products in the 'Suave' category I'd have just gone to a cheap drugstore. The new products seemed geared to a younger & less experienced demographic. Communication w/them was clunky & unsatisfying. I was disappointed to cancel, but felt I had no choice because who wants to over-pay for inferior merchandise??
label: negative
